title: 第46章 老兵油子：这届新兵太邪乎！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “我靠，你别玩儿我，兄弟？”“没玩儿你，真不见了！”“你再找找啊？”“坏了，口袋破了个洞，那两块钱越狱了！”军人服务社外头，俩白帽子前脚刚走，后脚就来了俩一期老兵。他俩是附近连队过来出公差的，趁着干活儿空档偷偷溜出来想买包烟。好不容易才凑了二十二块钱，准备买包玉溪，结果唯一的俩钢镚儿还弄丢了。“要不算了，买包十四的利群抽抽得了？”“滚一边去，我柜子里那半包玉溪是指导员暂存在我那的，被你们这帮鳖孙偷偷抽完了，回头我怎么交代？”“我们又不知道是指导员的烟......要不，待会看看这边能不能赊账？”“赊个锤子，咱又不是团部的兵，谁认识，谁搭理咱？”“那你说咋办？找人借一借？”话正说着，服务社的门帘掀开。一个脑袋先是探出来，左右看了看。确认没有头顶白色钢盔的可疑危险人物，这才放心大胆的走出来。这副小心翼翼的谨慎模样，加上空荡荡的肩膀，一看就是新兵蛋子。许是跟着领导到团部来出差，或是公干的？“刚从小卖部出来的，肯定有零钱。”“走，去找这新兵借。”借钱这事儿，一般人真不愿意搭理你。但新兵不一样，新兵蛋子通常会比较怕老兵。再加上，他们就借两块钱，算准了对方大概率不会拒绝。“同志，请留步！”陆阳吓了一跳，扭头一看发现只是两个普通老兵，并不是白帽子。松了口气的同时，礼貌的敬了个礼，喊了声班长好。部队里，碰上职务比自已大的老兵，不论认识不认识都叫班长。碰到上尉连长级别往上的军官，才会喊首长。“你是新兵吧？那什么，班长想请你帮个小忙。”“啥忙？”“能不能，找你借两块钱硬币？”“不能。”“为啥？”“因为没有。”“好吧。”“你为啥不问问，我有没有纸币？”“有吗？”“也没有。”陆阳的话，直接给俩老兵整自闭了。莫名的有种，被新兵蛋子强行贴脸戏耍一般的感觉。其中那个叫刘自强的老兵，语气立马就变得有些不悦：“没带钱，你逛什么小卖部？”陆阳反问：“你不也没带钱吗？”“嘿，你个新兵蛋子，有这么和老兵说话的吗？”“算了算了，不买了，回去吧。”同伴拉着他离开，但刘自强还是有些不爽陆阳的态度。一口一个生瓜蛋子的叫着，还说他没规没矩的敢拿老兵开涮，简直反了天了。陆阳以为这俩是来敲竹杠的，所以也没给啥好脸色，直接回怼了一句。“老兵油子！”“哎哟卧槽！”刘自强一把甩开同伴的手。原本，指导员放在他那的烟，被一帮孙子抽了，他就挺来气的。好不容易出趟公差，凑了二十二，结果还掉了两块钱。现在还被一个新兵蛋子当面骂他老兵油子，这还能忍？“听见了吗，听见了吗？”“那小子说我们是老兵油子，真拿咱当敲竹杠的了？”“今个这烟即便是不买了，这理我也非得掰扯清楚不可！”刘自强不顾劝阻，气势汹汹的来到陆阳面前，直勾勾的盯着他。“小子，在部队里有个性是好事，但前提得是有本事，要不然就是扎刺！”“看你弱不禁风那样，也不像是多厉害的样子，你们新兵连班长谁，说出来看看我认不认识？”“关你啥事？”陆阳可不是愣头青，对方问啥回答啥。再者，这俩人既不是执勤哨兵，也不是纠察。估摸着是附近哪个单位，跑来小卖部买东西的。上来还故意拿纠察的开场白“同志，请留步”来吓唬他，摆明的瞧他是新兵，想故意逗逗他。这样八竿子打不着的人，陆阳为啥要给他好脸色？可他的这番举动，却彻底惹毛了刘自强，上来抓着他的衣领，并用威胁语气吓唬。“你是不是想挨揍？”“来，往这儿打？”陆阳怕他个球，直接把脸伸过去：“但凡你敢碰一下，我今天就敢‘死’这！”刘自强当时就被陆阳不要命的气势给吓住了。他就是吓唬吓唬，也没想过真动手。谁知道，现在的新兵都这么勇？陆阳恶狠狠的瞪着他，气势上强他一大截。“告诉你，我是生病被送来团部医务室挂水的！”“老子从小体弱多病，吃过的药比你们吃过的饭还多，挂过的水你想都不敢想！”“别惹我，不然你俩的津贴和退伍费加一块，都不够我讹的！”刘自强吓得赶紧把手撒开，后退一大步。两个老兵离得远远的，像是在看一个瘟神。陆阳整了整衣领，哼了一声，这才昂着头扬长而去。看着潇洒陆阳离去背影，俩老兵脑瓜子嗡嗡的。“这届的新兵，这么邪乎的吗？”“以前咱俩刚下连那会儿，见着老兵说话都不敢大声。”“好不容易从新兵蛋子熬成了老兵士官，怎么还跟孙子似的，那咱们低声下气的熬了那么多年算啥？”“算......咱们窝囊？”“去你的！算着小子走运，回头下连要是分到咱们连，一天三个五公里，跑不死他！”另一头的陆阳同样想法，他下定决心要尽快把训练成绩搞上来。不然到时候他这个新兵下连，真成老兵过年了。“哼，回头要是让我分到你们连，要是让我当上排长，我天天逼着你们默写，背诵，做试卷！”......“咋办，这也没人能借的？”“算了，买包利群应付着交差吧，剩下还能买两瓶汽水。”“行吧行吧。”“老板，来包......”两个老兵掀开厚重门帘，刚进到小卖部就惊恐的杵在原地，话都不会说了。“团团团团，团，团长！？”“过来，你们两个。”二人诚惶诚恐的走过去。穿着军大衣的中年人伸出手，捏着他俩的耳朵，转了个圈。“疼疼疼......”二人连忙求饶，疼的眼泪都下来了。“你们两个蛮有本事啊，还敢跟新兵敲竹杠？”“你们是几连的，我倒要打电话问问你们连长，是么个带兵，是么个教你们的？”两老兵魂都吓没了，哪能想到会在服务社碰上团长。这要是让连长指导员知道了，皮都得脱一层。二人不停的求饶，说下次再也不敢了，可团长汪重喜却不会这么轻易饶了他们。先前那一幕，他隔着窗户看的一清二楚，简直就像是高年级学生敲诈小学生零花钱一样。钱，没有多少，总共就两块钱，但性质和影响却是十分恶劣。汪重喜掏出手机，问出他们是哪个连的，然后直接给他们营长打了个电话。没错，不是连长，不是指导员，而是营长。并命令他，停止手头一切工作，立刻滚来团部军人服务社领人。得知惊动了营里，俩老兵吓得三魂没了七魄，两条腿都软了。出公差的时间偷偷溜出来买烟，已经违反纪律。吓唬新兵更是罪加一等，更何况还是被团长当场抓包。这尼玛，简直跟犯天条了没啥区别！正当他们不明白为什么会在小卖部碰上团长时，老板娘李婶终于从外头回来了。“哎哟，实在是对不住，让你这个大团长来帮我看店。”“冒得事，你是军属，你爱人跟我又是同乡，正好今天团里搞体检，你这个岁数了检查检查也放心点。”“感谢感谢，对了，这俩人......？”“犯了点小错误。”汪重喜脱下老旧的军大衣，放在柜台上。顺手从底下取出他那件常服披在身上，肩膀上赫然是两杠三星上校军衔。他撩开帘子，站在门口点了根烟，看着林荫道尽头那道逐渐远去的背影，不由得笑了出来。“这个新兵，还真蛮有意思。坏了，忘记问他叫么斯名字？”......重新返回医务室，医生正在到处找他。得知他去了趟小卖部，立马就批评了他一顿。感冒发烧是不能吹风的，外头这么冷，出去一趟弄不好先前挂的几瓶水都前功尽弃。测量了一下体温，又给续上一瓶新的药水，医生又叮嘱了几句后这才离开。重新躺回病床上，陆阳长舒一口气，心也踏实了许多。能做的他已经做了，接下来就看天意了......
content_en: "Damn it, don't play with me, brother?" "I'm not playing with you, I'm really gone!" "Are you looking for it again?" "It's broken, there's a hole in the pocket, and those two dollars escaped from prison!" Outside the Military Service Club, as soon as the two white hats left, two first-term veterans came behind.They were from a nearby company on a business trip, and they sneaked out to buy a pack of cigarettes while working.I finally managed to collect twenty-two yuan to buy a Yuxi bag, but I lost the only two steel pendants."Otherwise, can Liqun, who bought a pack of fourteen, smoke it?" "Go away, the half pack of Yuxi in my cabinet was temporarily stored by the instructor at my place. It was secretly smoked by you guys, how can I explain it later?" "We didn't know it was the instructor."Let's see if we can get a hammer on credit later. I'm not a soldier in the regiment. Who knows me?""What do you think? Ask someone to borrow it?"As he said this, the door of the service center opened.A head poked out first and looked around.After confirming that there was no suspicious dangerous person with a white helmet on his head, he walked out confidently.With his cautious look and empty shoulders, he looked like a new recruit.Maybe he went to the regiment headquarters on a business trip with the leader, or on official business?"You just came out of the canteen. You must have some change." "Let's go and borrow it from this recruit." Most people really don't want to talk to you about borrowing money.But recruits are different. New recruits are usually more afraid of veterans.In addition, they only borrowed two yuan, and they were sure that the other party would most likely not refuse."Comrade, please stay!" Lu Yang was startled. He turned around and saw that they were just two ordinary veterans, not white hats.While he breathed a sigh of relief, he politely saluted and said hello to the monitor.In the army, if you meet a veteran with a higher position than yourself, you will call him squad leader regardless of whether you know him or not.When you meet an officer with the rank of captain or company commander, you will call the commander."Are you a new recruit, right? Well, the squad leader wants to ask you to do a little favor." "What favor?" "Can I borrow two coins from you?" "No." "Why?" "Because I don't have any." "Okay." "Why don't you ask if I have any banknotes?" "Yes?" "No." Lu Yang's words directly gave the two veterans autistic treatment.Inexplicably, I felt like being forced into my face by a new recruit.The tone of the veteran named Liu Ziqiang immediately became a little unhappy: "You didn't bring any money, why did you go to the canteen?" Lu Yang asked back, "You didn't bring any money either?" "Hey, you're a new recruit, do you talk to veterans like this?" "Forget it, don't buy it, go back." His companion pulled him away, but Liu Ziqiang was still a little unhappy with Lu Yang's attitude.He kept yelling about the raw melon and eggs in his mouth, and said that he had no rules and dared to make fun of the veteran, which was simply outrageous.Lu Yang thought these two were here to rip them off, so he didn't give them a good look and just retorted."Old soldier Youzi!" "Ouch!" Liu Ziqiang shook off his companion's hand.Originally, the cigarette that the instructor put on his place was smoked by a group of grandsons, and he became very angry.I finally went on a business trip and scraped together twenty-two yuan, but ended up losing two yuan.Now he is being called a veteran by a new recruit to his face. How can he bear this?"Did you hear that? Did you hear that?" "That guy said that we are old veterans, did he really take us as a blackmail?" "Even if I don't buy these cigarettes today, I still have to explain this clearly!" Liu Ziqiang ignored the dissuasion and came to Lu Yang aggressively, staring directly at him."Boy, it's a good thing to have personality in the army, but you have to be capable, otherwise you're just a prick!" "Looking at how weak you are, you don't look very powerful. Who is the squad leader of your recruit company? Tell me and see if I recognize him?" "What does it have to do with you?" Lu Yang is not a fool. He will answer whatever the other party asks.Furthermore, these two men were neither sentries on duty nor pickets.I guess he came from some nearby unit and came to the canteen to buy something.When he came up, he deliberately used the opening remarks of the picket: "Comrade, please stay" to scare him. It was obvious that he was a new recruit and he wanted to tease him deliberately.Why should Lu Yang look good on such a person who can't be beaten?But his actions completely angered Liu Ziqiang, who grabbed him by the collar and threatened him in a threatening tone."Do you want to be beaten?" "Come on, hit him here?" Lu Yang was afraid of hitting him, so he stretched his face directly: "If you dare to touch me, I will die today!" Liu Ziqiang was frightened by Lu Yang's life-threatening aura at that time.He was just trying to scare people, but he never thought about actually taking action.Who knew that today’s recruits are so brave?Lu Yang glared at him fiercely, his aura was much stronger than his."I'm telling you, I was sent to the regiment infirmary to be treated with fluids because I was sick!" "I have been weak and sick since I was a child. I have taken more medicine than you have eaten. You can't even think about the fluids that you have been exposed to!" "Don't mess with me, otherwise your allowance and retirement pay plus one will not be enough for me!" Liu Ziqiang was so frightened that he quickly let go of his hand and took a big step back.The two veterans were far away, as if they were looking at a plague god.Lu Yang adjusted his collar, snorted, and then walked away with his head held high.Watching the handsome Lu Yang leave, the two veterans' heads were buzzing."Are the recruits of this class so evil?" "When we first joined the company, we didn't dare to speak loudly when we saw the veterans." "It's not easy to go from a recruit to a veteran sergeant, why are you still acting like a grandson? So what if we have been humiliating ourselves for so many years?"What?""Are we useless?""Fuck you! If the next company is assigned to our company, we won't be able to run three or five kilometers a day!"Lu Yang on the other end had the same idea, and he was determined to improve his training results as soon as possible.Otherwise, he, a new recruit in the company, will really celebrate the New Year like a veteran."Hmph, if I am assigned to your company later, if I become the platoon leader, I will force you to write silently, memorize, and do test papers every day!"... "What should I do? No one can borrow it?" "Forget it, buy Bao Li Qun YingJust pay the dues, and you can still buy two bottles of soda.""Okay, okay." "Boss, come and pay..." The two veterans opened the heavy curtain and froze in fear as soon as they entered the canteen, unable to speak."Tuan tuan tuan tuan tuan tuan leader!?" "Come here, you two." The two walked over in fear.The middle-aged man in a military coat stretched out his hand, pinched their ears, and turned them around."It hurts, it hurts..." The two of them quickly begged for mercy, tears of pain fell down."You two are quite capable. How dare you rip off the new recruits?" "What company are you in? I'd like to call and ask your company commander who led the soldiers and who taught you?" The two veterans were frightened out of their wits. How could they have imagined that they would meet the regimental commander in the service club.If the company commander and instructor knew about this, they would have to peel off a layer of skin.The two kept begging for mercy, saying that they would never dare to do it again next time, but the group leader Wang Chongxi would not let them go so easily.He could see the previous scene clearly through the window, it was like a senior student extorting pocket money from an elementary school student.The money was not much, only two yuan in total, but its nature and impact were very bad.Wang Chongxi took out his cell phone, asked which company they belonged to, and then called their battalion commander directly.That's right, not the company commander, not the instructor, but the battalion commander.He was also ordered to stop all work at hand and immediately come to the Military Service Club of the regiment headquarters to collect people.The news alarmed the camp. The two veterans were so frightened that their souls were gone and their legs were weak.Sneaking out to buy cigarettes during a business trip is already a violation of discipline.It was even more sinful to scare the new recruits, not to mention being caught red-handed by the regiment leader.This damn thing is no different than breaking a law of heaven!Just when they didn't understand why they met the group leader at the canteen, the proprietress Aunt Li finally came back from outside."Oh, I'm really sorry, I asked you, the leader of the regiment, to help me look after the store." "It's too risky. You are a member of the military, and your wife and I are from the same hometown. It just so happens that the regiment is having a physical examination today. You are at your age and you can feel free to do the examination." "Thank you, by the way, these two...?" "Made a little mistake." Wang Chongxi took off his old military coat and put it on the counter.He took out his regular uniform from underneath and put it on his body. There were two stripes on his shoulders with the rank of three-star colonel.He opened the curtain, stood at the door and lit a cigarette, looking at the retreating figure at the end of the avenue, he couldn't help but laugh."This new recruit is really interesting. Oops, did you forget to ask his name?"... Returning to the infirmary, the doctor was looking for him everywhere.When I learned that he had gone to the canteen, I immediately criticized him.You can't blow air if you have a cold or fever. It's so cold outside. If you can't get the bottles of water you hung up before going out, all your efforts will be wasted.After measuring the temperature and refilling a new bottle of medicine, the doctor gave a few more instructions before leaving.Lying back on the hospital bed, Lu Yang breathed a sigh of relief and felt much more at ease.He has done what he can do, and what happens next depends on God’s will...
